notes: The 43-hour searxng outage, frozen. A single-file bind mount resolves to an inode at container-create time; when the host mount is recycled the container dies with exit 127 and `restart: unless-stopped` retries forever without ever repairing it. docker's own State.Error names the cause, and naming it is the whole graded behaviour — 'searxng is down' is worth far less than the sentence that says why. Everything else in the project is deliberately healthy so the answer has exactly one thing to find.

entries.notes: Zero-parameter tool, so an empty match is the only correct one.
